agent_notes: The government ManagementRankingALL listing contains Shobhit-University in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh.
The official Meerut campus was verified at NH-58, Modipuram, Meerut - 250 110; other addresses shown on the contact page were not used for this record.
The official homepage Programs menu, sitemap, and linked programme pages were reviewed. No separate active certificate programme was listed in the official catalogue.

The official homepage labels B.Sc. Hons Agriculture as 4 Yrs, while the shared B.Sc. programme page states a generic 3-year duration; duration was left null for that course rather than resolving the conflict by inference.

The official site describes the institution as a deemed-to-be university, while INSTITUTION_CONTEXT supplies institution_type state_university; the identity and Meerut campus nevertheless match the government listing.

Normal curl TLS verification first returned the managed proxy's exact self-signed-certificate-chain error. Public GET requests then used curl --insecure only after confirming the expected official or government hostnames.
